FACT_ID: sec09-R01 | anchor: A38
Posted numbers promise perfect weather only, so storms and crowds can ticket posted speeds, while crawling packs traffic and rightly yields aside. [A38]
Why it matters: group_hint speed-both-ways; prereq_hint sec09-F01; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec09-F01, sec09-F04.
Source: [A38 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0038]
FACT_ID: sec09-R02 | anchor: A38
Doubled speed more than triples stopping need, and sight caps speeds outright: four hundred feet for fifty, two hundred for thirty. [A38]
Why it matters: group_hint speed-math; prereq_hint sec09-F03; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec09-F03, sec09-F06.
Source: [A38 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0038]
FACT_ID: sec09-R03 | anchor: A38
Lefts bow to straight oncoming flow, circle mouths bow to inside wheels, and open corners bow to arrivals from the right. [A38]
Why it matters: group_hint yield-trio; prereq_hint sec09-F10; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec09-F10, sec09-F11.
Source: [A38 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0038]
FACT_ID: sec09-R04 | anchor: A38
All way stops rank arrival order first and right sides only on ties, unlike signless corners where the right always rules. [A38]
Why it matters: group_hint four-vs-open; prereq_hint sec09-F11; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec09-F11.
Source: [A38 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0038]
FACT_ID: sec09-R05 | anchor: A38
Officer hands outrank electric signals, and cane or dog walkers outrank everyone while forbidding horn noise near them. [A38]
Why it matters: group_hint top-priority; prereq_hint sec09-F08; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec09-F08, sec09-F09.
Source: [A38 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0038]
FACT_ID: sec09-R06 | anchor: A39
Flashing responders demand right edge stops held fast, while flashing school buses demand all way stops except oncoming lanes past dividers. [A39]
Why it matters: group_hint flash-split; prereq_hint sec09-F13; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec09-F13, sec09-F14.
Source: [A39 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0039]
FACT_ID: sec09-R07 | anchor: A39
Roundabouts yield to inside rings and foot crossings, enter on real gaps signed by lane, exit on right blinks, and never brake inside for joiners. [A39]
Why it matters: group_hint circle-flow; prereq_hint sec09-F16; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec09-F10, sec09-F16.
Source: [A39 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0039]
FACT_ID: sec09-R08 | anchor: A39
Hill wheels crank hard roadside to roll clear of traffic, while flat parking hugs near curbs far from travel lanes with brakes, gears, keys and locks set. [A39]
Why it matters: group_hint park-stance; prereq_hint sec09-F18; difficulty_hint 1; confusable_with sec09-F18, sec09-F19.
Source: [A39 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0039]
FACT_ID: sec09-R09 | anchor: A39
Stop signs and safety zones want twenty five clearing feet, hydrants want ten, and curbs want less than one. [A39]
Why it matters: group_hint park-feet; prereq_hint sec09-F20; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec09-F20.
Source: [A39 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0039]
FACT_ID: sec09-R10 | anchor: A40
Empty dark calls high beams, crowds and fog call lows, and stubborn opposing highs earn quick flashes then right edge eyes, never revenge glare. [A40]
Why it matters: group_hint beam-duel; prereq_hint sec09-F22; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec09-F22, sec09-F23.
Source: [A40 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0040]
